blocks.text:
Welcome to Brazil! On arrival in Rio de Janeiro, transfer to your hotel. Rio has green hills, blue sky, beautiful bays, islands and marvellous beaches: Brazil’s second-largest city after São Paulo and one of the most beautiful in the world, with the famous black-and-white mosaic promenades of Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon.

In the afternoon, a half-day excursion to Sugar Loaf. The first stop is Urca Hill, with its wide viewing area, restaurant and bar; from Sugar Loaf, enjoy a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains and islands, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ on Corcovado. Then visit the central districts of old Rio, with their old churches, monasteries, the city’s cathedral and colonial-style buildings, before returning to the hotel.

blocks.text: Day 2 · After breakfast, a tour through the city to the station, where an eco-friendly train climbs through the jungle to the top of Corcovado, with spectacular views of the Tijuca Forest, home to monkeys and exotic birds. At the summit, 710 metres above sea level, stands the symbol of Rio, the 38-metre statue of Christ the Redeemer, built in 1931, with a breathtaking panorama of the city and its surroundings: the Rio–Niterói Bridge, the Botanical Garden, the legendary Maracanã Stadium, Sugar Loaf and more.
